feature: Customer Portal v2 -- Billing (/portal-v2/billing). Covers the real plan-state section wired in Git #1611: GET /api/portal/billing/subscriptions drives 'Your plan' -- current recurring subscriptions, live Stripe status, renewal/period date and seat count. Receipts + 'Manage payment in Stripe' (Git #1237) predate this pass and are not re-asserted here. Monitoring-plan tier cards / add-on toggles stay fixture (DECIDED not-yet-wireable, #1594/#1128) and are out of scope.
notes: THE LOGIN BLOCK IS NOT OPTIONAL. /portal-v2/* sits behind ProtectedRoute.
shaneapp://runTest hits the DEPLOYED build, not the local worktree -- this manifest asserts green only after the pushed commit is deployed.

NO FIXTURE FALLBACK FOR PLAN STATE (Git #1611). Unlike Receipts, the plan-state section has no design fixture to fall back to -- per the platform's hard rule, subscriptionsLive.ts's dataState is a strict three-state loading/live/error with NO fixture branch. A tenant with zero recurring client_services rows is dataState:'live' with an honest empty message (BILL_PLAN_EMPTY), not borrowed content.

THE HARNESS TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL ACCOUNT HAS NO RECURRING SUBSCRIPTION. BS1/BS2 below assert the honest live-but-empty state that account actually sees -- this is NOT a failed-read case, it is dataState:'live' with plans:[]. A future manifest pass against an account with a real client_services row (billingType=recurring_monthly) should assert the populated plan row (service name, Stripe status text, seats, renewal date) instead.

STRIPE'S RAW STATUS VOCABULARY IS RENDERED HONESTLY, NOT NARROWED (portal-billing.ts:303, subscriptionsWire.ts). No coverage here for a populated row's exact status string since the harness account has none -- see the note above.
THERE IS NO NEGATIVE TEXT ASSERTION IN THIS HARNESS, and an array in `textContains` is ANY-of, not all-of. Every all-of assertion here is its own step.
NO `select` STEPS. UiTestExecutor.cs cannot drive a native <select>; this page has none in the asserted flow.
ENV VARS required: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD.
